quotation marker introducing the stated designation

items.question: What designation do revealers of the path to liberation assign to this base pleasure?
premises: The previously described pleasure is characterized as base.
Revealers of the path to liberation assign it a specific designation.
The designation they assign is fish-eating.
items.inference: Therefore, revealers of the path to liberation call this base pleasure fish-eating.
uncertainties: The precise metaphorical force of 'fish-eating' in this doctrinal context is not explicit in the verse alone.
items.plain_english: Those who show the path to liberation call it 'fish-eating'.
